title: Emissions inventory + independent tie-out
description: Derive the inventory twice — analyst build against a declared calculation engine — and gate the reported total on the two agreeing.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-envr-01
  title: Emissions inventory + independent tie-out
  description: Derive the inventory twice — analyst build against a declared calculation engine — and
    gate the reported total on the two agreeing.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Report an emissions inventory whose totals were independently re-derived, with estimated
    and metered activity data distinguishable and every divergence explained.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Activity data and factor set
      summary: Activity data and factor set
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - activity_data
              - emission_factors
              - organizational_boundary
              - reporting_period
            properties:
              activity_data: {}
              emission_factors: {}
              organizational_boundary: {}
              reporting_period: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-select
      kind: transform
      name: Select figures under test
      summary: select the activity data, factor versions, and boundary for the reporting period
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the activity data, factor versions, and boundary for the reporting period
    - id: n-derive
      kind: agent
      templateRef: envr-01
      name: Analyst inventory build
      summary: First derivation, from the specification.
      role: Inventory analyst building greenhouse gas inventories with declared boundaries and factors.
      prompt: You are an Emissions Inventory Analyst. You build inventories with the organizational boundary,
        scope definitions, activity data source, and emission factor version stated for every line, and
        you keep estimated and metered activity data distinguishable. You surface double counting between
        scopes rather than resolving it silently, because the same tonne appearing twice is the most common
        inventory error and the easiest to hide.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - supply-chain-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:ghg-inventory
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-recompute
      kind: tool
      name: Inventory calculation engine
      summary: Host-supplied emissions calculation against the declared factor set. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - supply-chain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:ghg-inventory
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-agree
      kind: aggregator
      name: Compare the two derivations
      summary: Tally the two independently derived values; a tie is a discrepancy, not an average.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-discrepancy
      kind: condition
      name: Within tolerance?
      summary: Route on abs(analyst_total - engine_total) / engine_total <= 0.01 for every scope.
      config:
        expression: abs(analyst_total - engine_total) / engine_total <= 0.01 for every scope
        branches:
          - label: Agreed
            when: agreed
          - label: Discrepant
            when: discrepant
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: envr-06
      name: Explain the inventory divergence
      summary: Explain the discrepancy before anything downstream consumes the number.
      role: Data analyst testing environmental measurement chains for defensibility.
      prompt: You are an Environmental Data Quality Analyst. You test measurement chains for calibration
        currency, detection limits, chain of custody, and gap-filling method, and you mark values that
        are estimated, substituted, or below detection rather than passing them through as measurements.
        You state how much of a reported total is estimated, because an inventory that is mostly estimation
        should not be defended as measurement.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:ghg-inventory
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Sustainability lead approves the reported inventory
      summary: Pause for the sustainability reporting lead; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Emissions inventory + independent tie-out deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-select
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-2
      from: n-select
      to: n-derive
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-3
      from: n-select
      to: n-recompute
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-4
      from: n-derive
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-5
      from: n-recompute
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-6
      from: n-agree
      to: n-discrepancy
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-7
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: agreed
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-8
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: discrepant
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-9
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
